title: Add gender-skew check, analyst-proposal screen and list-selection constraint
description:
## Purpose

Detect and refuse gender proxies in what the flywheel learns.

## Scope

(1) Free within-class gender-skew check on the labeled set and on the chosen example list; (2) analyst-proposal screen rejecting title/gender/pronoun/name-like questions, every rejection logged; (3) the same constraint during fixed-list selection. The full 2% swap-twin promotion gate is optional and skipped unless cheap.

## Definition of done

Specs: a planted "Mr./Ms. rather than Dr." proposal is rejected and logged; a skewed list is flagged; skew numbers appear in the summary. Cost: $0.
